title: Srivijaya

endonym.roman: as in the Kedukan Bukit inscription, 683 AD

capsule: The maritime thalassocracy of Palembang, controller of the Malacca and Sunda straits and great patron of Buddhist learning. Crippled by the Chola naval raid of 1025, it persisted as a diminished power until eclipsed by Javanese and Malay successors in the thirteenth century.
attestation: Boundaries from Seshat Cliopatria (Bennett et al., Scientific Data 2025; CC BY 4.0), digitized from standard historical atlases (Times Atlas of World History; Kinder & Hilgemann; Shepherd 1926) at ~0.07° resolution. Known from inscriptions, Chinese records, and archaeology; territorial extent is a scholarly construct over a network of ports — drawn extents are highly conjectural. Confidence: low; rendered with maximal uncertainty.
